summary: This PR adds real, useful hardening to the OWNER_ENGINE->task-gateway auto-dispatch path (NEEDS_OWNER_CLARIFICATION gate before submit/start, a duplicate_found block before start, a None-confidence crash fix in query.py, a --repo override, deduped REQUIRED_TASK_SECTIONS, and a genuinely new integration test suite), and none of the subprocess calls are shell-based or otherwise injectable. However, dispatch_to_task_lifecycle()'s own docstring asserts text handed to task-gateway.py is 'always final_output ... never raw_text', but for the auto-start path the --prompt-file staged for `task-gateway.py start` is written with raw_text (the ungated Owner message), not final_output -- this becomes the permanent, real prompt.txt a worker AI executes from, directly contradicting the OWNER_ENGINE-gate-is-NON-NEGOTIABLE principle this same codebase asserts repeatedly (including elsewhere in this very file). Combined with an overclaimed ordering guarantee around the new credit-accountant.py propose call and an incomplete repo-derivation heuristic that silently defaults to the wrong repo for 4 of the system's 7 known GitHub repos, this round does not fully close the safety gaps it claims to, and the raw-text-bypass issue in particular is a real regression against the codebase's own stated invariant for a feature whose entire point is safe autonomous dispatch. Recommend a targeted follow-up fixing these three points rather than a full restart.
issues: scripts/prompt_gateway/gateway.py: dispatch_to_task_lifecycle()'s docstring states text passed to task-gateway.py is 'always chat_result["final_output"] ... never raw_text', but in the `start` action the second real call (`task-gateway.py start --prompt-file <path>`) stages raw_text (the un-gated raw Owner message) into that file, not final_output -- contradicting the documented invariant and, more importantly, bypassing the OWNER_ENGINE gate for the actual permanent task prompt (ai-os/tasks/<task_id>/prompt.txt) a worker AI will execute from. This directly conflicts with the 'AI will only work on that output prompt given by the OWNER_ENGINE software' NON-NEGOTIABLE directive quoted in run_owner_engine_gate()'s own docstring in scripts/task-gateway.py.

scripts/task-gateway.py cmd_start: the new credit-accountant.py `propose` call is placed after `veridian-task.py create`, which (per this file's own pre-existing comment two lines below) already enables+starts the real systemd unit -- so the stated guarantee that 'an approved-or-rejected increment-1 row exists before the worker's own checkpoint loop can reach it' is not actually enforced; there is a real, if narrow, race window between the worker service starting (inside `create`) and this `propose` subprocess call completing.

scripts/prompt_gateway/gateway.py: KNOWN_REPOS only lists 3 of the system's documented 7 GitHub repos (PROTOCOL_OWNER_AI.yaml system_definition lists claude-control/compliance-tracker/projexa as only the 'primary' 3 of 7). For any full task spec naming one of the other 4 repos, _derive_repo_from_spec() silently falls back to DEFAULT_REPO='claude-control' with no warning surfaced, risking automatic dispatch of real work (git worktree, PR) against the wrong repository unless the caller remembers to pass --repo explicitly.
